zh: 新增“禁止脱战回血”开关，默认关闭、保留原版。开启后拦截模组管理单位的原版脱战逐步回血和立即回满，已有与新召唤单位均生效；技能回血、吸血和地图原生单位保持原样。已回的血不扣回，关闭也不补回此前拦截的血量。
弦者卡片新增“技能虚化无敌”选项，默认原版。关闭后保留动作、位移和特效，移除对应技能的无敌保护；蓝方、红方、随从和未配队均适用，下次直召生效。
改进梦华的原生剧情阶段适配：分别记录每次召唤的梦华与虚空配对及落点，减少多组同场、晚加载剧情对象和阶段收尾互相干扰。默认保留原版41%阶段保护及联动，确认原生收尾后才清理对应配对。
梦华卡片新增“剧情联动：保留／跳过”开关，默认保留、下次直召生效。选择跳过会连同虚空联动、41%阶段保护和联动专用招式一起跳过；地图剧情、其他血量下限与“不倒下”不受此选项控制。
索敌挂钩晚加载、部分注册失败或注销未确认时继续限频处理；控制器、组件或对象身份变化后重新核对。私有锁定目标写入后读回，未知结果不再当作已经成功清锁，失败目标指派会重试。
补齐尸体索敌修订的遗漏：同一轮处理期间单位死亡、目标变得不可选或停止清理后，发原生指令前重新确认，不再继续向已离场的旧名单下令。早期0.40.3中对应的过度完整修复说明已划掉。
修复死亡随从仍被助战、跟随或移动指令驱动，以及新单位复用地址时沿用旧随从状态或镜头分类缓存的问题。血量读不清时暂缓控制并保留恢复记录；镜头目标离场后释放对应缓存。
减少支持循环内重复的视口、对象名单及目标查询；无随从时跳过无用玩家查询，战斗名单按变动更新索引，无删除时不再复制整张名单。随从血条重建或原生状态重置后重新刷新。
新增可自定义的“解散全部随从”快捷键，位于“快捷键 → 随从”，默认未绑定。支持组合键、保存、解绑及与单位／怪物池按键的冲突检查；只走随从解散流程，蓝方、红方和未配队单位保留。换图后的旧按键请求会取消。
后续界面和更新说明维护中文、英文。原日语、法语、德语、西班牙语用户升级后，会显示各自语言的说明并暂用英文；语言设置旁始终保留四语说明，顶栏语言菜单可直接到达。需要其他语言维护，可提GitHub Issue或邮件联系，哪怕只有一位用户需要也会恢复该语言更新。
本版新增选项、状态提示及已知的相关指令答复已补齐中英。旧语言设置和历史公告保留迁移信息；旧快捷键文件保留原绑定，新增解散键为空。旧版游戏内模组尚未支持解散键时明确提示更新，原有按键仍可设置。
已通过152组离线回归、108个Lua语法及NPC／Actor双启动检查，并在浏览器原型验证语言弹窗、设置入口和解散键绑定。离线重复查询计数降低不等于实测游戏帧率提升；梦华连携、虚化、长战索敌、帧时间及不同NPC组合仍需实机验证。
已知风险：旧式生命／杀气下限恢复记录的热重载对象身份风险仍未迁移。重载前先遣散梦华随从，关闭无仇恨、不倒下与无限杀气，停止清理并确认恢复；无法确认时先保留诊断并退出游戏，不用热重载代替清理。菜单滚轮失效反馈仍待复现。
en: Added Prevent out-of-combat healing, off by default. When enabled it blocks native gradual regeneration and instant full healing outside combat for existing and newly summoned mod-managed units. Healing skills, life steal and native map actors are unchanged. Health already restored is not removed, and disabling the option does not refund blocked healing.

Xian Zhe cards now offer Skill invulnerability, with native behavior as the default. Turning it off removes the corresponding skill protection while keeping animations, movement and effects. Applies to subsequent standalone summons on blue, red, companion or no team.

Improved Meng Hua’s native story-phase adaptation. Each summon tracks its own Xu Kong partner and landing anchors to reduce interference between simultaneous groups, streamed story actors and phase cleanup. Native 41% phase protection and the linked moves remain the default; the corresponding pair is cleaned up after native completion is confirmed.

Meng Hua cards now offer Story link: keep / skip, with keep as the default. Skipping also skips the Xu Kong link, its 41% phase protection and exclusive linked moves. Applies to subsequent direct summons. Map story actors, other health floors and Undying are not controlled by this option.

Targeting hooks continue paced recovery after late loading, partial registration failure or unconfirmed removal. Controller, component and actor identity changes are checked again. Private target writes are read back; an unknown result no longer counts as a cleared lock, and failed assignments are retried.

Closed gaps in corpse targeting: actors can die, become untargetable or leave during one processing pass. Native commands now recheck that state and do not continue using a roster retired by cleanup. The corresponding overly broad fix claim in 0.40.3 has been struck through.

Dead companions no longer receive assist, follow or movement commands. Replacement actors at reused addresses no longer inherit old companion state or camera classifications. Unknown health pauses control while retaining recovery records, and departed camera targets release their cached classification.

Reduced repeated viewport, actor-list and target queries within support ticks. Idle companion updates skip unnecessary player queries; combat roster lookups use an index invalidated on changes, and pruning avoids copying an unchanged list. Companion bars refresh after widget reconstruction or native state resets.

Added a configurable Dismiss all companions hotkey under Hotkeys → Companions, unbound by default. Supports modifier chords, saving, unbinding and conflicts with unit or monster-pool keys. Uses companion-only dismissal; blue, red and no-team units stay. Queued presses from an old map are cancelled.

Future interface updates and release notes will be maintained in Chinese and English. Japanese, French, German and Spanish users receive a notice in their language after upgrading, then temporarily use English. All four notices remain beside the language settings and are reachable from the top language menu. Request another language through a GitHub issue or email; even one user is enough to resume support.

New options, status text and known related command replies are available in Chinese and English. Migration information and historical translations are retained. Existing hotkey files keep their bindings and the new dismissal key starts unbound. Older in-game mods show an update requirement for dismissal while their existing hotkeys remain editable.

Passed 152 offline regression groups, syntax checks for 108 Lua files and both NPC/Actor startup fixtures. Browser prototype checks cover language notices, settings access and dismissal-key binding. Lower query counts are not measured game FPS gains. Native linked phases, phasing, long fights, frame times and individual NPC combinations still need in-game validation.

Known risk: the old health/Sha-Chi floor recovery format still has actor-identity risks across hot reloads. Before reloading, dismiss Meng Hua companions, disable No aggro, Undying and Infinite Sha-Chi, then stop and clean up and confirm recovery. If recovery cannot be confirmed, retain diagnostics and exit the game instead of hot reloading. The menu-wheel report still needs reproduction.
ja: ほかの言語でこのModを使っている方がどれくらいいるのか分からず、利用状況を知る手がかりとなるご意見も届いていません。そのため、今後は中国語版と英語版のみを更新します。ほかの言語の更新をご希望の方は、私のGitHubでIssueを作成するか、メールでご連絡ください。お使いの方が一人でもいれば、その言語の更新を継続します。ご支援ありがとうございます。
画面はひとまず英語で表示されます。このお知らせは「Settings → Language」の言語設定のすぐ下で、いつでも日本語で読み直せます。
fr: Je ne sais pas combien de personnes utilisent mon mod dans d’autres langues et je n’ai reçu aucun retour permettant de le savoir. Je ne mettrai donc désormais à jour que les versions chinoise et anglaise. Si vous avez besoin d’une autre langue, ouvrez une issue sur mon GitHub ou envoyez-moi un e-mail. Même si une seule personne l’utilise, je continuerai à mettre cette langue à jour. Merci pour votre soutien !
L’interface s’affiche provisoirement en anglais. Vous pourrez toujours relire cet avis en français juste sous le choix de la langue, dans Settings → Language.
de: Ich weiß nicht, wie viele Menschen meine Mod in anderen Sprachen nutzen, und habe dazu bisher keine Rückmeldungen erhalten. Deshalb werde ich künftig nur noch die chinesische und die englische Version aktualisieren. Wenn ihr eine andere Sprache benötigt, erstellt bitte ein Issue auf meinem GitHub oder schreibt mir eine E-Mail. Auch wenn nur eine einzige Person eine Sprache nutzt, werde ich sie weiter aktualisieren. Vielen Dank für eure Unterstützung!
Die Oberfläche wird vorerst auf Englisch angezeigt. Diesen Hinweis könnt ihr jederzeit auf Deutsch direkt unter der Sprachauswahl in Settings → Language nachlesen.
es: No sé cuántas personas usan mi mod en otros idiomas y no he recibido comentarios que permitan saberlo. Por eso, a partir de ahora solo actualizaré las versiones en chino e inglés. Si necesitáis otro idioma, abrid un issue en mi GitHub o enviadme un correo electrónico. Aunque solo lo use una persona, seguiré actualizando ese idioma. ¡Gracias por vuestro apoyo!
La interfaz se mostrará por ahora en inglés. Podréis volver a leer este aviso en español justo debajo de la selección de idioma, en Settings → Language.
